decision_basis: At 48x trailing earnings, observed EPS decline despite higher group profit and externally funded capital-intensive expansion create unfavorable current purchase compensation. Backlog and better margins prevent a strong sell; unavailable June cash/debt further limits confidence without being the sole bearish reason.
manager_assessment: Disagree with the manager’s neutral direction: I independently give more weight to already-falling EPS at 48x and externally funded expansion. Improving margins/backlog bound the negative score; missing current funding detail reduces confidence rather than creating the sell by itself.
score_interpretation: Signed strength of the present evidence-supported thesis; not a win probability or historical edge.
